alt: Aerial view of the Mira-Bhayandar double-decker flyover near Mumbai, showing a wide 4-lane approach road abruptly funnelling into a thin 2-lane bridge over the city
story: A brand-new Mumbai Metro Line 9 double-decker flyover in Mira-Bhayandar went viral in January 2026 when aerial footage showed its four-lane stretch abruptly narrowing to two lanes — and the road authority's official response was that it was 'planned' and 'not a design flaw.'
why_funny: They built half the bridge and called it a feature.
